content.comment_body: After reviewing other threads, I saw there are three generations of the [product_name]. Is there a reference or link with a table showing different model numbers and their associated generations? Alternatively, can someone clarify this list for me? 08A8 - 8.0 (1st), 08A7 - ?, 08A6 - ?, 08A5 - ?, 08A4 - ?, 08A3 - ?, 08A2 - ?, 0BA1 - ?, 0BA0 - 8.2 (3rd). By the way, I found a useful resource for the 8.2 model number.

In the referenced topic, the discussion focuses on the third generation of 0BA8 [product_name] units. The current [product_name] 8.3 represents the fourth generation of 0BA8. Please refer to the attached document. The upcoming release will be [product_name] 8.4.

[user_name], based on the information so far, how would the model [article_no] be categorized? Would it be considered 8.0, 8.1, 8.2, or 8.3? I'm looking for a list of different [product_name] variants and their corresponding version numbers.

6ED1 052-XXXXX-0BA0: 1st series of all [product_name] units. 6ED1 052-XXXXX-0BA1: 2nd series. 6ED1 052-XXXXX-0BA2: 3rd series. 6ED1 052-XXXXX-0BA3: 4th series. 6ED1 052-XXXXX-0BA4: 5th series. 6ED1 052-XXXXX-0BA5: 6th series. 6ED1 052-XXXXX-0BA6: 7th series. 6ED1 052-XXXXX-0BA7: 8th series. Then comes the 0BA8 series, which is the 9th series of all [product_name] units. The posted document applies to this 0BA8 series.

analysis.insight_summary: The user is looking for a clear reference guide that connects [product_name] hardware article numbers to their generations or version numbers. Available documentation or forum resources seem scattered and unclear, making it difficult to accurately identify hardware models and their progression.
analysis.user_expectations: The user expects to find an official and straightforward table or documentation listing [product_name] module article numbers with their corresponding generations or version numbers for easy and reliable reference.
